database_migration_summary: M1.3 establishes the minimal custom accounts.User before business migrations, plus durable hashed email-action tokens and revocable native-session records. No learner, entitlement, curriculum, assessment, billing, or other business model exists.
latest_test_summary: M1.3 passes 25 Django/Pytest security and lifecycle tests, system/migration checks, npm check/portability, continuity/diff checks, Expo Doctor/dependency checks, and iOS/Android JS exports. Hosted CI passes on exact Python 3.13/PostgreSQL 17/Redis 7.2/Celery and Node 24. Real email delivery, Heroku, native device keychain/simulator/store builds, and universal/app links remain unverified.
high_risk_items: Execution breadth across web, iOS, Android, AI assessment quality, community moderation, and cross-platform commerce.

Milestone 2 must prove automated official-scope and Rule Obligation completeness with primary/official authority and lawful multi-source reconciliation; Sourcebooks are optional enhanced reconciliation, not a launch dependency.
Cross-scenario projections, anonymous claim security, private public-page overlays, entitlement transitions, and cross-device orchestration require explicit integration/security tests before GA.
Official NCBE scope/source changes must pass source-drift and revalidation workflow; future exam scopes remain provisional until governing materials exist.
exact_next_task: After M1.3 review and acceptance, select the next bounded Milestone 1 foundation slice from the controlling acceptance order; do not begin product-domain work from continuity alone.
